# Akash Vetiver Export — Complete Business and Product Guide

## About

Akash Vetiver Export is a family-run direct-to-customer business based in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, India (PIN 608801). Founded by Avinash and Mathivanan, we grow, harvest and handcraft vetiver root products. We sell directly to customers across Tamil Nadu and all over India with no middlemen and no wholesale reseller layers.

Vetiver is known by several names in Tamil tradition: vettiver, vilamichai, ramacham, and khus or khus khus. We use 100% pure vetiver roots in every product. We never mix coir or synthetic materials with our vetiver. This is the most important quality difference between our products and what is sold by resellers on Meesho, Flipkart and IndiaMART.

## Why buy from us

Source pricing: We are the manufacturer. Customers pay what the craft is worth, not 2x or 3x after reseller markup.

Pure vetiver: No coir mixing. Every piece uses genuine vetiver roots with natural fragrance.

Handcrafted: Every piece is made by our family in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu.

Direct ordering: Customers contact us on WhatsApp to confirm availability, requirements and delivery. No payment is collected on the website.

Delivery across India: We deliver to all districts of Tamil Nadu and across India.

## Products and prices

### Garlands (Vetiver Malai / Vettiver Malai / Vilamichai Malai)

Wedding Garland Pair (product-malai-pair): A matched pair of vetiver garlands for bride and groom. Decorative thread work. Price: from 650 INR per pair.

Royal Vetiver Garland (product-malai-royal): Full vetiver garland with ornate finish. Price: from 650 INR.

Green and Gold Garland (product-malai-green): Vetiver garland with green and gold thread. Price: from 650 INR.

Neon Vetiver Garland (product-malai-neon): Vetiver garland with bright neon thread accents. Price: from 650 INR.

Flower Vetiver Garland (product-malai-flowers): Vetiver garland with flower decorations. Price: from 650 INR.

Red and Yellow Vetiver Garland Pair (product-malai-redyellow): Pair of garlands with red and yellow thread. Price: from 350 INR.

Gold Ornament Vetiver Garland (product-malai-gold): Garland with gold ornament details. Price: from 350 INR.

### Door Hangings (Vetiver Toran / Vetiver Door Hanging / Vilamichai Toran)

Flower Toran (product-toran-flowers): Vetiver door hanging with flower embellishments.

Vetiver Door Curtain (product-toran-fringe): Floor-length vetiver root door curtain fringe.

Auspicious Toran (product-toran-auspicious): Door hanging with auspicious Tamil symbols.

### Decorative and Ceremonial (Vetiver Decor / Vilamichai Craft)

Vetiver Peacock — Mayil (product-peacock): Handcrafted vetiver peacock sculpture. A traditional Tamil decorative piece.

Vetiver Bell Hanging (product-hanging-bells): Circular hanging decoration with vetiver and bells.

Vetiver Vel Spear (product-vel): Ceremonial vetiver vel used in Murugan worship and festivals.

Vetiver Kodi Flag (product-flag): Festival flag with vetiver and crochet border.

Vetiver Ganesha (product-vetiver-ganesha): Ganesha figure crafted from vetiver roots.

Vetiver Scrubbers Pack of 3 (product-scrubbers-pack-3): Natural vetiver root bath scrubbers.

## Occasions served

Tamil weddings: Vetiver garlands (vettiver malai) for bride and groom are traditional. Vetiver door hangings are used at the wedding venue entrance.

Housewarming (gruhapravesam): Vetiver door hangings bring natural fragrance and auspiciousness to a new home.

Temple festivals: Vetiver vel, flags and decorative pieces for Murugan temples and festivals across Tamil Nadu.

Gifts: Vetiver scrubbers, peacock figures and decorative pieces as eco-friendly, culturally meaningful gifts.

Bulk orders for events: We supply vetiver garlands in bulk for wedding organizers, event planners and temples across Tamil Nadu.

## Delivery areas

We deliver to all districts of Tamil Nadu including: Cuddalore, Villupuram, Chidambaram, Pondicherry, Nagapattinam, Thanjavur, Kumbakonam, Mayiladuthurai, Madurai, Trichy (Tiruchirappalli), Chennai, Coimbatore, Salem, Erode, Tirunelveli, Vellore, Kanchipuram, Dharmapuri, Namakkal, Karur, Pudukkottai and all other districts. We also deliver pan-India.
